per_port.note: Between 2.5 A and 5.0 A the fuse may or may not trip (Bourns: hold and trip at 23 C); the JST contact is rated 3 A. A sustained load in that band is not guaranteed to be cut.
per_port.track_basis: IPC-2221 outer-layer fit, 1 oz (35 um) copper assumed
sources: JST EH catalogue: 'Current rating: 3 A AC/DC (AWG #22)'; https://www.jst-mfg.com/product/pdf/eng/eEH.pdf
Bourns MF-MSMF series rev. BE: MF-MSMF250/16X Vmax 16 V, Ihold 2.50 A, Itrip 5.00 A, R1max 0.100 ohm; https://www.bourns.com/docs/Product-Datasheets/mfmsmf.pdf

input_trunk.supply_basis: BOM supply: ROBOTIS SMPS 12 V 5 A
input_trunk.track_basis: IPC-2221 outer-layer fit, 1 oz (35 um) copper assumed

arm.advice: Run the arm on two ports (base yaw + shoulder + elbow on one, the wrist and gripper on another) so a chain's normal current stays well under 2.5 A; a full stall of every joint trips the fuses, which is the intended protection. ROBOTIS servos also have their own overload shutdown.

voltages.supply_note: 12 V is the XL430's maximum input; a supply that regulates high (or a 3S pack at 12.6 V full charge) exceeds it. Use a supply set to 12.0 V or below, or 11.1 V nominal.

tvs.note: The TVS absorbs fast surges (hot-plug, regeneration spikes); it clamps above every servo's rated input, so it is not overvoltage protection for a wrong supply.
tvs.source: Vishay SMBJ series doc. 88392 (09-Jan-2024): SMBJ15(C)A VWM 15 V, VBR 16.7-18.5 V, VC 24.4 V at IPPM 24.6 A; https://www.vishay.com/docs/88392/smbj.pdf

voltages.reverse_polarity: not protected: the screw terminal is unkeyed. Check polarity before connecting the supply.

half_duplex_circuit.basis: ROBOTIS TTL communication circuit (ttl_circuit.png, X-series e-manual)
half_duplex_circuit.kept: two tri-state buffers on one DATA line, direction from a transmit-enable line (high = transmit), 10 kOhm pull-ups to 5 V on DATA and RXD, 10 kOhm pull-down on the enable
half_duplex_circuit.changed: 74LVC2G241 -> 74AHCT1G126 (transmit) + 74AHCT1G125 (receive), because the FT232R's guaranteed 3.2 V high is below the LVC part's 3.5 V input high at 5 V
half_duplex_circuit.added_from_pollen: Data-line protection as in Pollen Robotics' production converter (github.com/pollen-robotics/elec_grabette, Apache-2.0): 150 ohm series, 5.1 V Zener clamp, 100 ohm PTC (Murata PRG18BB101MB1RB, 24 V) toward the connectors, so 12 V on the data pin cannot reach the buffers
half_duplex_circuit.direction_source: FT232R CBUS2, factory default TXDEN (DS_FT232R Table 3.x: 'Factory default configuration is TXDEN'), so no EEPROM programming
